definitions.scope: Consented website browsers only; IDs can reset and do not identify people or app installs.
definitions.useful_session: At least one pick reasoning block visible for five continuous foreground seconds; reasoning_v2 only.
definitions.cohort: First observed session_started per browser in the selected week; not proof of a first-ever visit.
definitions.return: Another observed session at least 24 hours and less than seven days after cohort entry; only fully observed seven-day windows count.
definitions.missing: Declined consent, blocked requests/storage, other devices and legacy page-load events are outside this funnel. Fewer than 20 observations are flagged.
